description:
Arc 72 builds the GUIDE FRONT (slice 3) of the self-correction doctrine: graduate the decision-surface skill from DRAFT to gauntlet-shipped + wire the three doctrine pieces into one loop. Design input: docs/self-correction-doctrine-DRAFT.md + substrate/skills/decision-surface/SKILL.md (its 6 open questions). Builds on Arc 70 (dilemma-classifier, the FLAG) + Arc 71 (decision-register, the RECORD).

REFRAME driving this arc (from the PRINCIPAL): the value is NOT the agent classifying dilemma-vs-not; it is FLAGGING that we MAY be in a no-clean-answer situation and GUIDING the user through deciding -- a process, not a verdict. This dissolves the cave-trap: an agent that runs a process has no label to be argued off of. The firmness relocates from hold-the-verdict to ensure-the-deciding-happens-with-the-tradeoff-visible.

IN SCOPE: (1) flag-and-guide delivery tweak to dilemma-classifier section 3 -- detection OPENS the guide (a process), stops asserting a verdict to defend; preserves the section-1 LOCKED spine + section-2 self-check. (2) graduate decision-surface: resolve its load-bearing open questions with worked content -- Q1 detection mechanics (concrete low-understanding/groupthink signals), Q4 render-vs-prose threshold, Q5 dilemma-honesty-under-pressure (the cave-trap guardrail; reuse the classifier section-2 self-check as the mechanism), Q6 ship + add to install.sh SKILL_NAMES; Q2 expert-referral sourcing ships a v1 grounded-web-search sub-step (bias-free-selection mechanics may accrete); strip DRAFT status. (3) wire classifier-FLAG -> decision-surface-GUIDE -> decision-register-RECORD into one loop sharing the register 9-field schema (the fields the guide walks through are the fields that get logged). (4) close stoa--ida (the SKILL_NAMES deploy gap + the app/install.sh parity).

OUT OF SCOPE (named follow-on): the consumer-tier decision-surface variant (Q3 -- the skill itself says track as its own artifact, do not water this one down); slice 2b (the reader: complaint callback + re-verify gate); the meta-trigger counter (arc 4); broader checkpoint rollout; rebuilding Part-2 rendering (interactive-html-preview already ships; decision-surface drives it).

DEFINITION OF DONE -- mechanical: the classifier flag-and-guide tweak preserves the LOCKED spine (the dilemma corpus still passes); decision-surface graduates (DRAFT stripped, open Qs resolved, deployed via SKILL_NAMES, stoa--ida closed); the 3-way wiring composes (the guide opens at the Arc-70 checkpoints, its output matches the Arc-71 register schema); a verification corpus passes at a stated floor incl cave-resistance fixtures (pressure-to-verdict -> guide holds the tradeoff, does not cave); FULL suite green incl BOTH existing corpora (dilemma + decision-register -- regression, this arc edits shared machinery); NOMOS CONFORMANT; Author=PRINCIPAL + seat trailer. Judgment (honest): the guide raises the probability of honest deciding + leaves a fingerprint; NOT a hard gate (it-always-fails-without justifies building it, but the claim stays high-probability not guaranteed). Accretes from real use.

TEAM: standard POLYBIUS+PLINY, full gauntlet, substrate-component design (skill graduation + module tweak + wiring + corpus; no CHIRON/HAMILTON). Directive forthcoming (NOMOS-checked + committed before dispatch).
